Hi Emily — welcome! Glad to hear Nebula is moving forward.

High-level answers first, then Ben can share the formal checklist and intake form we use for marketplace listings:

- Primary PO destination: please send initial PO to finance@redwood.com. For marketplace listings we ask that the email subject include our internal vendor code and the marketplace listing ID so Finance and Marketplace Ops can link the request quickly.
- PO format: we accept either line-item or lump-sum POs; line-item is preferred when possible (product SKU + unit price + quantity).
- Vendor code / listing ID: we will assign a vendor code once intake is complete. For now please include your company legal name exactly as it appears on tax forms and a placeholder like "Listing: nebula-pending" on the PO.

Ben — looping you to provide the vendor intake workbook and required documents (W-9, ACH / wire instructions, vendor contact, etc.). Vanessa, FYI on the AWS/GCP marketplace details in case any marketplace-specific routing is needed.

Emily — I'll follow up after Ben confirms the checklist and we issue the provisional vendor code.

Thanks,

Hi Emily — thanks for reaching out. Short checklist below and attached is the intake workbook we use for vendor activation. Please complete and return all items as a single package to finance@redwood.com to avoid delays.

Required (for US vendors):
1) Completed vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx (attached) — legal name, DBA, tax ID, remittance address, vendor contact
2) Signed W-9 (PDF)
3) Bank ACH details OR wire instructions (PDF/letter on bank letterhead)
4) Sample Purchase Order or draft PO (PDF) — include the Redwood marketplace listing or your proposed SKU lines if available
5) Point of contact for billing disputes

Optional but helpful:
- Marketplace partner ID (AWS/GCP/Azure)
- Expected monthly spend (helps us provision marketplace listing quicker)

Routing and format notes:
- Send as a single email to finance@redwood.com with subject: "Marketplace PO: Nebula Cloud — Vendor Intake"
- Please put your preferred payment terms (Net 30 / Net 45 / Net 60) on the PO. If you request non-standard terms we may need an approval path which takes up to 5 business days.
- For marketplace listings, include a line in the PO: "Marketplace Listing ID: [listing-id]" once assigned. If you don't have it yet, include "Marketplace Listing: pending".

Attachments: vendor_onboarding_form.xlsx (please fill all tabs)

Ben Carter
Sr. Finance Ops — Marketplace
Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
